text: Sync inputs are initially checked, and existing resources are disabled. captureState selects input:checked:enabled, so existing resources are not sent to the add loop. Calendar discovery also substitutes an existing placeholder with name and existing=true, without uri; the optional uri access in captureState allows that placeholder to be excluded. Preserve the disabled-selection boundary rather than registering a checked existing item again. This is scoped source behavior, not a runtime duplicate-prevention proof for every caller. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Existing sync resources stay displayed but are excluded from new registration
